name: CAM_HERO
howto: PerspectiveCamera at three.position looking along three.direction (lookAt(target_1m)), up = three.up. Sensor fit is HORIZONTAL: hold the horizontal FOV and on every resize set fov = 2*atan(tan(hfov/2)/aspect) in degrees. The glTF camera's yfov is only right at the render aspect. Lens shift is NOT in the glTF. Reproduce it either with cam.setViewOffset(w, h, -shift_x*w, -shift_y*w, w, h) (w,h = canvas px; shifts are fractions of the width because fit is horizontal; negative offsetY moves the window up) or, after updateProjectionMatrix(), cam.projectionMatrix.elements[8] += 2*shift_x; cam.projectionMatrix.elements[9] += 2*shift_y*aspect; then projectionMatrixInverse.copy(projectionMatrix).invert(). Verticals stay parallel because the camera pitch is 0 (level=True in chamber.py).
